notes.title: 2025 Life update
notes.notes:
Hi friends, as it became usual once a year, happy to say I'm still alive, still in the army 3 years through the war. 

August 2025 marks 75 000 copies of Titan chaser sold since its release, and your support helps me significantly to keep my sanity during this crazy time. I no longer feel myself as a game developer, although I hope to return as soon as our neighbors stop claiming our cities and people as their and killing my friends in the process.

Until that happens, I can only continue do what is right as the part of Ukrainian Armed Forces, count on your support through my existing games and continue to absorb this horrible experience as inspiration for the future projects in case I get the opportunity to make them.

I hope next year I'll have something more gamedev-related to say, but for now thank you for being here and cheers!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/35ba0bede617fb64c96da2180794a346baba06d9.jpg"]

notes.title: My 2024 Life update
notes.notes:
Still alive, still relatively healthy both physically and mentally. Lost many friends but now helping to bring the fight on enemy territory and hopefully change the future of our war. 

Thank you all for you support, I've been feeling it all these two years in the army as a boost for my morale and financially through the sales of Titan Chaser and my other games, and it helps significantly. 

Can't wait for the time I can make games again. 
Yearly selfie as a proof I still exist. Cheers to all, over and out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/0211420e5b772267ec881116c2ad18427eda533a.jpg

notes.title: My 2023 Life Update
notes.notes:
August 25 marks exactly 1 year since I joined Ukrainian Armed Forces to defend my home from russian invasion. So I hope you understand why I don't have any updates on released or upcoming games. This year I trained in Great Britain (thanks friends for all you help to us!), and then served in relatively safe places, doing mostly paperwork, until recently I moved to the frontlines to work with UAV data and artillery. 

But more importantly, few days ago russians killed my best friend. He died as a hero, in battle, and gave his life for a possibility to evacuate civilians from occupied village. So my next year in armed forces won't be just "serving", I am gonna be as effective in driving russians from our land or burying them here as I can possibly be, in his memory, and because they robbed me of a life full of joy during our daily walks with our dogs with him and his wife. So you are not gonna see any gamedev-related news from me for another year at least, or however long this hell will continue. Every copy of my game bought by you will help me to keep my sanity as I'm gonna use this money on something that brings me joy between the work. I'm not sure how often I would be active here on Steam, so if you want to know if I'm alive and well from time to time, you can check my twitter (or X, whatever it would be in a few months) 

Thank everyone who supported me for all these years and will do so in future, without you I would be entirely different person. 
Cheers,
Stas

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/61c963995eed637310d2c61b8340fdc3301bcb0a.jpg

notes.title: My life update
notes.notes:
As you may know, Russia invaded my country, Ukraine, on February 24, 2022. Since that day I was helping my country as a volunteer, driving military and humanitarian aid, refugees and journalists. I've seen with my own eyes a destruction made by russian missiles, broken families and pain that is going to stay with us for generations. Between all that I had no energy left to publish some statement or to work on my games. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/9f6d05aa79544c84a76b10f0a33c001397659c58.jpg

Also, maybe you know that Steam blocked all payments to Ukrainian developers, and that doesn't help at all in surviving russian invasion - a lot of people thought they have passive income and stopped working to defend our land only to see their payments indefinitely delayed. I hope Valve will fix this as they promised until the end of April, so we don't need to be worried about our back while facing enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/b06110b89d9f295d962672f4721a69f238adf803.jpg

With all that, I just want to share my plans with you - I feel ready to continue game development, at least few days a week when I have some free time from helping Ukraine to win this war. If you want to help Ukraine too - please consider to push your governments to impose tougher sanctions on Russia and stop buying their oil and gas - because that money are feeding russian war machine to kill Ukrainian people. Thank you for your help and support, I know the majority of the world are helping us!

Слава Україні!
Stas Shostak

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Italian localization, better steering and other fixes
notes.notes:
In first post-release update you will find:


 Italian localization, big thanks to Antonio Peragine (PeraByte)
 Tweaks in steering and driving (the car is more responsive now when the speed is lower and more stable when the speed is higher)
 Smoother satellite tower stairs - no need to jump to climb them anymore
 Wyvern position on the satellites has been fixed.
 Character shadow at the beginning of the intro cutscene will no longer scare new players
 Car radio will automatically turn off in the end credits to not overlap with outro music
 More menu backgrounds shot and shared by the community


also I want to thank you all again for incredible reception of the game - after 9 months of Early Access and two days in release there are almost 190 reviews with Very Positive rating - this means a lot to me!

And this picture (also taken by the community) is a hint for the next update: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/f501ace8893e77f0a70ed79b6290d92b4c59b351.png

Cheers,
Stas

notes.title: Version 1.0 - new titan, epilogue and more
notes.notes:
Congratulations! With the help of the community Titan Chaser got its 1.0 update! What's there:

 next titan
 epilogue with 4 cozy endings
 a lot of new lines for main character
 Increased clarity of voice
 new Satellite dishes, and you can climb them now
 rain with awesome VFX on a car windshield
 bugfixes and probably new bugs :)
 SP-LA and IT localizations are temporarily turned off to add new stuff  in upcoming updates
 Chinese and French localizations are on their way


If there is no major bugs I'm going to change release state of Titan Chaser in a few hours and celebrate the full release! Thanks again for your support and I hope the endings of Titan chaser bring you some warm feelings.

Cheers!

notes.title: Upcoming update and full release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/490fccd416187796329e0dd45cf47f8d592da4c3.gif
Better quality gif - https://twitter.com/StasShostak/status/1363092827417288707

In a few days I'm going to release 1.0 version of the game with the next titan and the epilogue (and a lot of small bugfixes and improvements as usual). I hope you won't be disappointed by the end result.

The base price will not be increased - I feel like I tend to make small unpolished experiences, so it would be fair to charge less than average indie game price for its roughness.

After the full release I will continue to support Titan Chaser, fix the bugs and maybe even add some content - but the main story I wanted to tell will be finished with this upcoming update.

Thank you all for playing and supporting me during this journey!

Cheers,
Stas

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/72f1d0caca3ed12d73fc1ba933371b7f37a495cd.png

notes.title: Update 0.3.0: Halloween Special
notes.notes:
Play Special Halloween level to find Jasper following the pumpkin's trail and learn the life story of a "Woodville Witch". This is a permanent addition to Titan Chaser so you will be able to play it anytime in future even after Halloween.

Other updates:
[olist]
 All levels will be open in start menu after you get the keys from Jasper during the first playthrough. So now even if you stuck on some level or don't want to finish it you can still try any level in the game.
 Voice should be more clearly audible between the world sounds and music
[/olist] 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/9758d9b1347718db37a1d8c2f5a4c2c2562960ce.png

I want to thank you all again for appreciating my game, there are already more than 5000 players and almost 130 Very Positive reviews, I just can't express how happy I am to see my unusual game played by all of you despite a handful of problems in game design and presentation. 

See you soon with another updates,
Cheers,
Stas

notes.title: 0.2.4 Car hotfix
notes.notes: Car physics has been tweaked (again) - it should feel a bit heavier, slower to accelerate and easier to stop, without loosing the ability to climb over the hills

notes.title: Update 0.2.4: Achievements
notes.notes:
I know, I know, it's still not a new titan, but I experience technical problems with next level I'm doing and decided it's better to update the game with something I can do right now to show it's not abandoned.

So, from now on there are achievements in Titan Chaser (I will add more with every big content update). Also, there is a new spotlight design on you car, I think it's better for the aesthetic. There are some new structures on the map as a hint for the next night - and I think it's gonna be live just in a 5-6 days.

Also I want to thank all 4500 players for trying my game and more than 100 people who felt something after the play session and wrote a review. Every single one of them matters, especially for a small game like mine, so your contribution is invaluable!

Cheers,
Stas

notes.title: Update 0.2.3: Key Binding
notes.notes:
Now you can change your control schemes as you like. It's a bit ugly at the moment, but I think it's better to make it work faster than to polish it until it looks good.

I had two crazy weeks and I think now I'll be able to add content in Titan Chaser more frequently, but now when I said it I'm afraid something will go sideways as it always does. Anyway, thanks for playing my small experimental experience and I hope future updates will not disappoint you.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.2.2 - Third person (in car) view, 100 reviews and 4000 players
notes.notes:
Hey there!
 That's pretty much it: now you have an ability to change your view when inside the car - look around you to find how to switch the camera and enjoy driving with better visibility and camera freedom. 

Also, I'm proud to report Titan Chaser got 4000 players and more than 100 reviews with Very Positive rating in two months being in Early Access! This is huge, thank you all for that! It's a massive milestone for me as a developer, and I'm trying not to screw it up, I hope you like the direction Titan Chaser is moving and enjoy it as much as I am.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 - Headlight switch and some experiments
notes.notes:
This is a small one, as usual after major updates.


 There is a dedicated headlight switch now (and spotlight switch moved a bit to make a room for new one) - Not only you can make some interesting screenshots with all of your lights working, but there is an option to turn the headlight off if it's too distracting for your driving or creates some visual artifacts on the windshield.
 Controllers are partially working at the base level of menu (not in settings or level selecting window, but at least now you can reset checkpoint or exit level with controller only)
 Gas stations have new interior now (I'm preparing them for something in future updates)
 You can push some objects at gas station, like barrels or boxes - now it's for fun only, but I'm exploring new possibilities with physics and its impact on performance and potential gameplay value

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2.0 - Next Titan and more stuff
notes.notes:
Heeey, I know it's been too long since the last update, but I tried to make a lot of new small things right together with the new titan (and release of The Last of Us 2 wasn't helping at all). So, in this update you can find:


 The main feature everyone was trying during their first play session - you can flush the toilet now. Okay, I'm just kidding, main feature is a new titan obviously (but toilet is flushable, that's still true).
 New settings: you can invert Y axis for looking around and deactivate Aurora Borealis in the sky - this can significantly improve performance on some computers (laptops especially)
 New UI system (please report if you find any bugs, I spent a lot of time fighting with problems, but it seems stable now)
 You have shadow now - should be more immersive experience
 Loading time, RAM management and overall stability of the game have been improved
 There are some kind of reflection simulations in the mirrors now
 You can leave spotlight on the top of your car at any position now
 TV in your room will remember its state if you turned it off or on


I hope you'll like the new experience and it was worth to wait for it a little while. For the next few weeks I will work on fixes and smaller improvements, so please report if you find any problems, I'll put them on my TODO list.

notes.title: 2000 players, pause before a bigger update
notes.notes:
Last night Titan Chaser reached pretty important milestone for me - 2000 players (and 60 steam reviews with Very Positive score), and I want to thank all of you for your support!

In the mean time, I'm working on a bigger update (new titan and more content), so I'll go silent for a week or two (unless some urgent update or fix needed). I'll post work in progress stuff in my Twitter as usual, and announce here when the update is up and running.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.1.8 Wondering Titans, car physics, level selection and more
notes.notes:
Wondering titans are in different locations - more scouting and driving to find both now
 Adaptive car physics - better torque when on hills or going backwards, usual when on plain, so it's not too sensitive when there is no need to be
 Level selection in menu  - you can replay finished levels without losing progress
 No more floating houses in Woodville (this was not a mystery, sorry if you had some theories about it)
 Some new points of interest around the world
 no more flashlight when you point on trigger zones. I thought it would be helping, but it seems it was rather distracting
 You can now switch of the pointer in settings - for cleaner view or better screenshots
 Some new voice lines

notes.title: Update 0.1.7 - Screen ratios, jump, community screenshots
notes.notes:
I fixed glitches with screen ratios other than 16:9 - now all buttons should work normally with any screen ratio (please report if you still encounter any problems except background images - they just shot in 16:9 ratio)
 Now you can jump over small obstacles. With that you probably can break the game in so many ways, but at least you will be able to get back to the car if you jumped out of it on the other side of a barrier or something. 
 You can see some of community screenshots in the main menu now (no spoilers with the titans, only a car and landscapes) Every now and them I will pick up new best shots and add them into the game if you don't mind


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 0.1.6 - Car physics, Bright City, lighthouse
notes.notes:
Car physics revisited - climbing uphill should be much easier now (but not all the hills are approachable without momentum though), and steering should be a bit smoother
 I changed Bright City entirely
 Lighthouse is a proper lighthouse now
 Few decor additions in various places


Working on this update I completely broke (not on purpose) and then repaired grass visual appearance, so please report if you encounter any new issues with grass or maybe trees - it should be just like before, but maybe I missed something. Thanks for playing!

P.S.: I made a hotfix (steering in left direction was faster than right) for this one, so please update the game again if you tried it immediately after I post this.

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
No new titans, sorry folks, I just try to make the experience itself more comfortable and accessible with smaller things before I dig in for a large chunks of new content. So, in 0.1.5 you might find

 FOV slider in the settings
 Seat level adjustment - you can go a bit up and down to find more comfortable position
 Running is a tiny bit faster now
 Car physics: better steering and traction control
 Small text and object adjustments here and there

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
first of all - Original Soundtrack for Titan Chaser is available - All revenue from its sales goes to krapka;KOMA who made the music for this game. New tracks from their Quarantine Beats project will be added there as they publish them.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1327240/Titan_Chaser_OST_Quarantine_Beats_by_krapka__KOMA/ 

And other important stuff:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477360/8f8d24ed2574a735b2532ef409526350788f2d21.gif

[olist]
 Tape is interactive now. I know you wanted to insert it all this time, this bugged EVERYONE who I saw playing.
 Wyvern will react to *honk* now while she is resting.
 Transition to the next night is less buggy now, and at third night you get the ability to drive around without any tasks while I'm working on next titans
 Some lines are less frequent now (spotlight reaction for example), I'm trying to minimize repetitiveness watching streams and letsplays.
 Hint about satellite towers is written on your task list now, not just a verbal line like it was before.
 Music radio buttons have more visible switches now, so you don't need to look for them in the dark
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
This is a small one, but I think a satisfying update

 There is some resolution now when you escort the wyvern home
 Walking titans were fixed and now they walk as they should without glitching over trees and other stuff

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Road markers are destroyable now, they slow you down, but no more complete stops and going back and forth to pass it
 some collision traps were fixed (my condolences to all of you who was evacuated from the space between bed and chair)
 some lines are less repeatable now
 road crossings were cleaned from obstacles like lights and road markers (you can report if I missed something)

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
In this update I tried to fix some urgent problems to smooth out the experience of players.


 Mouse look behavior was changed to more natural
 Look sensitivity slider in settings
 All sound sources remixed to be more natural and less "mono" when you around them, so crickets sound should be more bearable now and music is in full stereo while you in car or close to it
 Car physics revised a bit, it should be easier to go up the hills now, and using brake
 Repeating "now I should switch it off" line at the end of wyvern path should be fixed now
